BiblicalUsage: gûwphâh is the word for a corpse, a dead body. In 1 Chronicles 10:12, the text says "and took away the body of Saul."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of gûwphâh I do not force more than it gives: a corpse, a dead body.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
